summary: PASS. The fresh-conversation regression reported in iteration_20 is FIXED. Backend now persists push_proposal on the ai_msg document (server.py L1028) and GET /conversations/{id}/messages returns it; frontend renders inline button from (m.pushProposal || m.push_proposal) (ChatPanel.jsx L265). Verified end-to-end from the real UI in a BRAND-NEW conversation (fresh /chat load, empty state visible, no prior conversationId): first message was an explicit push request -> assistant reply rendered inline [data-testid=review-push-button] AND it persisted (still visible at 5s and at 15s -- previously vanished ~1-2s after conversationId flip). Modal did NOT auto-open. Clicking Review & Push opened the dialog at the review step; clicking Approve & Push created a real commit on GitHub (single attempt, no retry needed). Casual message '/lol nice' in a truly fresh conversation returned push_proposal=None (verified via API).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py L1026-1029: ai_msg now correctly includes push_proposal alongside content. Simple, minimal, correct fix.

GET /api/conversations/{conv_id}/messages (server.py L1045-1047) returns full message docs (only _id excluded), so push_proposal flows to the frontend on refetch as expected. No schema change needed on the endpoint side.

ChatPanel.jsx L265-273: inline button correctly reads (m.pushProposal || m.push_proposal), tolerating both the optimistic (camelCase) and refetched (snake_case) shapes. This is what makes the button survive the conversationId->refetch cycle in fresh chats.

Follow-up nit (not blocking): the useEffect at ChatPanel.jsx L43-49 still unconditionally refetches on conversationId change. With the push_proposal persisted this is now idempotent and safe, but merging by id would be cleaner and would avoid a full DOM re-render for the optimistic user message.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Skills loaded: ai-testing-core, ai-testing-llm. Iteration_20 regression (fresh-conversation inline button vanishing) is fixed. Both persistence pieces (backend push_proposal on ai_msg + frontend camelCase-or-snake_case read) are in place. If a future change touches ChatPanel.jsx send() or the /conversations/{id}/messages endpoint, retest by: register new user, connect PAT, reload /chat (empty state), send explicit push message as FIRST message, then wait 15s and assert [data-testid=review-push-button] is still visible. Casual messages in fresh convos return push_proposal=null (verified). Note: 'lol nice' sent AFTER an approved push in the SAME conversation can produce a follow-up push_proposal from the LLM due to context (observed count went 1->2); this is LLM behavior, not the regression under test, and does not occur in truly fresh conversations.
rca of the issue: iteration_20 root cause was: (1) backend did not persist push_proposal on ai_msg, and (2) frontend useEffect on conversationId refetched messages on first message of a new chat, overwriting the optimistic assistant message that carried the pushProposal field. Fix applied: (1) backend ai_msg now includes push_proposal at server.py L1028; (2) frontend inline-button render at ChatPanel.jsx L265 reads (m.pushProposal || m.push_proposal), so after refetch the snake_case field from the DB keeps the button rendered. Verified in a real fresh-chat UI run.
